cands.name: Charles Smith
cands.bio: Fayetteville attorney and Democrat who has represented North Carolina House District 44 since January 2023. He was a Cumberland County assistant district attorney, handling mostly domestic violence and child abuse cases, then moved to private practice. He holds a UNC law degree.
cands.gaps: The pages we could read did not show any bills he sponsored (the sponsored-legislation list was empty). They also gave no statements or actions from him on data centers, development and growth, homestead property taxes, foreign or investor ownership of land, immigration and H-1B, police pay, abortion, or school choice and teacher pay. We found no documented controversies, no foreign ties and no notable endorsements; Ballotpedia says it identified none for 2024 or 2026. We did not find his birth date or when, if ever, he lived outside North Carolina beyond college and law school. His only stated positions come from a 2021 survey, and he did not complete Ballotpedia's 2024 or 2026 surveys.

local.label: Roots 100: Ballotpedia lists his birthplace as Fayetteville, NC, and his campaign site says he was born and raised in Cumberland County and still lives in Fayetteville.

qual.background: State House member since January 2023, after serving as a Cumberland County assistant district attorney and then working as a private-practice attorney in administrative, corporate and civil law, including for government entities.
qual.why: He has about three years of legislative service plus a law career that involves interpreting and arguing statutes. Committee assignments were not counted.
